versions.changelog: Add startup gates, go/no-go score, pre-commit stop-loss and a repository structural-defect checklist. Add QUICKSTART.md.
Separate whole-system audit, latest-delivery review, and Owner-led rebaseline with evidence and authority gates.

- Initial release of Project Lifecycle Navigator 1.0.0.
- Bilingual (EN/中文) project guidance for non-technical users and AI Coding Agent workflows.
- Structured navigation for three lifecycle stages: New Project Intake, Mid-Project Realignment, and Code Review & Upgrade Planning.
- Clear rules for routing, questioning, and language selection; no default code generation—focus on scoping, review, and actionable plans.
- Consistent, friendly user interviews with strict boundaries around MVP definition, feature creep, and handoff criteria.
